prompt:
A desktop app screen, landscape 16:10, rendered edge to edge as the screen itself (no browser window, no device frame). The app is "Tagalong", a crew of AI pets. Screen: "Your crew".

Layout, region by region:
1. Top bar: white, "Tagalong HQ" at left in a rounded friendly sans, tabs "Crew", "Office", "Meetings" (Crew selected), and a "Hire a pet" button with a hot-pink (#FF6F91) fill at right.
2. Main area, about 70% width: a roster grid of five large cells on soft pastel grounds (pale pink #FCE4EC, pale blue #E3F2FD, butter #FFF3C4), each cell holding a big cute pixel-art creature with a thick white keyline around it, a coloured ribbon name plate under it, and two lines: role and a one-line note. Cells: "Scout · Generalist · Explains anything on your screen", "Ink · Writer · Turns notes into clear emails", "Bolt · Backend engineer · Reads stack traces for fun", "Sage · Researcher · Compares every source", "Pixel · Frontend engineer · Fixes what users see". Sage's cell shows a small orange badge "Needs you"; Ink's shows "In Room 2".
3. Right panel, about 30%: white panel "Live now" with a small top-down pixel map of the office showing two meeting rooms, and below it a meeting card "Launch blog post · Room 2" with three avatar dots and the latest message "Ink: Done. It now leads with what users get." and a meter "4 of 12 calls".

Style: premium, clean and friendly product UI; flat pastel fills, white keylines, generous spacing, crisp rounded sans for text; standard buttons and tabs.
